# Scope : province
# Parameters:
# TYPE - culture or faith
# SCOPE - which to add
# FACTOR - starting factor
E_kCAFG_create_struct = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { exists = $SCOPE$ } }
		error_log = "Create Struct - Invalid Scope !"
	}

	dummy_male = {
		create_story = {
			type = kei_cafg_granularity_factor_struct
			save_scope_as = new_struct	
		}
	}

	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:new_struct }

		scope:new_struct = {
			set_variable = {
				name = $TYPE$
				value = $SCOPE$
			}

			set_variable = {
				name = factor
				value = $FACTOR$
			}
		}

		add_to_variable_list = {
			name = kCAFG_province_$TYPE$_structs
			target = scope:new_struct
		}

		add_to_variable_list = {
			name = kCAFG_province_$TYPE$s
			target = $SCOPE$
		}
	}
	else = { error_log = "kCAFG Error while creating $TYPE$ struct in province [THIS.Province.GetNameNoTooltip]" }
}

# Scope : province
# Parameters:
# TYPE - culture or faith
# SCOPE - which to remove
E_kCAFG_remove_struct = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { exists = $SCOPE$ } }
		error_log = "Remove Struct - Invalid Scope !"
	}

	every_in_list = {
		variable = kCAFG_province_$TYPE$_structs

		limit = { this.var:$TYPE$ = $SCOPE$ }

		save_scope_as = removed_element

		prev = {
			remove_list_variable = {
				name = kCAFG_province_$TYPE$_structs
				target = scope:removed_element
			}

			remove_list_variable = {
        		name = kCAFG_province_$TYPE$s
				target = $SCOPE$
			}
		}
	}
}

# Scope : province
# Parameters:
# TYPE - culture or faith
# SCOPE - which to set
# FACTOR - 0-1 value
E_kCAFG_set_struct_factor = {
	if = {
		limit = { $FACTOR$ > 0 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					is_target_in_variable_list = {
						name = kCAFG_province_$TYPE$s
						target = $SCOPE$
					}
				}
			}
			E_kCAFG_create_struct = {
				TYPE = $TYPE$
				SCOPE = $SCOPE$
				FACTOR = $FACTOR$
			}
		}
		else = {
			every_in_list = {
				variable = kCAFG_province_$TYPE$_structs

				limit = { this.var:$TYPE$ = $SCOPE$ }

				set_variable = {
					name = factor
					value = $FACTOR$
				}
			}
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			is_target_in_variable_list = {
				name = kCAFG_province_$TYPE$s
				target = $SCOPE$
			}
		}

		E_kCAFG_remove_struct = {
			TYPE = $TYPE$
			SCOPE = $SCOPE$
		}
	}
}

# Scope : province
# Parameters:
# TYPE - culture or faith
# SCOPE - which to set
# FACTOR - 0-1 value
E_kCAFG_add_struct_factor = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				is_target_in_variable_list = {
					name = kCAFG_province_$TYPE$s
					target = $SCOPE$
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { $FACTOR$ > 0 }
			E_kCAFG_create_struct = {
				TYPE = $TYPE$
				SCOPE = $SCOPE$
				FACTOR = $FACTOR$
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		every_in_list = {
			variable = kCAFG_province_$TYPE$_structs

			limit = { this.var:$TYPE$ = $SCOPE$ }

			change_variable = {
				name = factor
				add = $FACTOR$
			}

			E_kCAFG_check_struct_removal = { TYPE = $TYPE$ }
		}
	}
}

# Scope : province
# Parameters:
# TYPE - culture or faith
# SCOPE - which to set
# FACTOR - 0-1 value
E_kCAFG_subtract_struct_factor = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			is_target_in_variable_list = {
				name = kCAFG_province_$TYPE$s
				target = $SCOPE$
			}
		}

		every_in_list = {
			variable = kCAFG_province_$TYPE$_structs

			limit = { this.var:$TYPE$ = $SCOPE$ }

			change_variable = {
				name = factor
				subtract = $FACTOR$
			}

			E_kCAFG_check_struct_removal = { TYPE = $TYPE$ }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { $FACTOR$ < 0 }
		E_kCAFG_create_struct = {
			TYPE = $TYPE$
			SCOPE = $SCOPE$
			FACTOR = $FACTOR$
		}
		scope:new_struct = {
			change_variable = {
				name = factor
				multiply = -1
			}
		}
	}
}

# Scope : struct
# prev : province
E_kCAFG_check_struct_removal = {
	if = {
		limit = { var:factor < V_kCAFG_absorption_threshold }

		save_scope_as = removed_element

		if = {
			limit = {
				var:factor > 0
				prev = {
					any_in_list = {
						variable = kCAFG_province_$TYPE$_structs
						scope:removed_element.var:$TYPE$ != this.var:$TYPE$
					}
				}
			}

			prev = {
				random_in_list = {
					variable = kCAFG_province_$TYPE$_structs

					weight = {
						base = 0
						modifier = {
							add = {
								value = this.var:factor
								multiply = 10000
							}
						}
					}

					limit = { scope:removed_element.var:$TYPE$ != this.var:$TYPE$ }

					change_variable = {
						name = factor
						add = scope:removed_element.var:factor
					}
				}
			}
		}

		prev = {
			remove_list_variable = {
				name = kCAFG_province_$TYPE$s
				target = scope:removed_element.var:$TYPE$
			}

			remove_list_variable = {
				name = kCAFG_province_$TYPE$_structs
				target = scope:removed_element
			}
		}
	}
}
